_doc: Canonical team-mark registry (every current constructor). Marks identify the team only (nominative use), are never recoloured, cropped or stretched, and keep their aspect ratio; dark-ink marks sit on a light chip (bg=light). Provenance is internal; nothing about rights is printed in the UI. Source priority: first-party team/brand assets, then official CDNs, then other authoritative sources.
approvedBy: owner request 2026-10-02 (show team logos next to team names)
